content: In the field of medicine, the term gravidity refers to the total number of times a woman has been pregnant. A gravida is a term used to describe a pregnant woman. A nulligravida or gravida 0 refers to a woman who has never been pregnant. A primigravida or gravida 1 describes a woman who is pregnant for the first time or has been pregnant only once. A multigravida refers to a woman who has been pregnant more than once. This can be further specified as gravida 2 (also called secundigravida), gravida 3, and so on, depending on the number of pregnancies. An elderly primigravida is a term used to describe a woman experiencing her first pregnancy at the age of 35 or older. The term gravida is often used in conjunction with para and abortus to provide a more detailed account of a woman’s obstetric history. In entomology, the term gravid is used to describe a mated female insect. In biology, gravid refers to the condition of a female live-bearing fish or snake when it is carrying young internally.
